nep413_payloads.name: doctest_callback_url
nep413_payloads.description: The `into_nep413_payload()` doctest, with a browser wallet callback URL.

nep413_payloads.name: spec_example
nep413_payloads.description: The `recipient` string printed in NEP-641 itself, with no callback URL.

nep413_payloads.name: no_callback_url
nep413_payloads.description: No callback URL. The `Option` is a bare `0x00` in the Borsh preimage.

nep413_payloads.name: empty_callback_url
nep413_payloads.description: A callback URL that is present but empty: `0x01` followed by a zero length prefix, not `0x00`.

nep413_payloads.name: path_empty
nep413_payloads.description: Top-level authorization: `recipient` names the signer alone, with no arrow.

nep413_payloads.name: path_deep
nep413_payloads.description: Four resolver hops: `recipient` joins them after the signer, bottom-top.
nep413_payloads.recipient: mainnet: leaf.near -> a.near -> b.near -> c.near -> top.near @ 2026-08-05T07:28:00Z

nep413_payloads.name: timestamp_whole_second
nep413_payloads.description: A timestamp that is already whole: truncation must neither add nor remove anything.

nep413_payloads.name: timestamp_epoch
nep413_payloads.description: Subseconds are truncated down, so this timestamp reaches `recipient` as the bare epoch.

nep413_payloads.name: message_empty
nep413_payloads.description: An empty payload becomes an empty NEP-413 `message`.

nep413_payloads.name: message_unicode
nep413_payloads.description: Multi-byte payload and callback URL: Borsh length prefixes are byte counts, not character counts.
nep413_payloads.payload_json: {"message":"こんにちは, Near! 🌐","nonce":"UJOp1NIXBWIMrWgIknhgq6Nj5RgBhUSJuL8VQp1BqUo=","recipient":"mainnet: wallet.near @ 2026-08-05T07:28:00Z","callbackUrl":"https://wallet.example/コールバック"}

signed.name: ed25519_top_level
signed.description: Top-level authorization signed with a full-access ed25519 key.

signed.name: ed25519_callback_url
signed.description: The same, with a callback URL in `via.extra`, which is part of the signed payload.

signed.name: ed25519_deep_path
signed.description: Delegated authorization, two resolver hops below the top-level resolver.

signed.name: secp256k1_top_level
signed.description: Top-level authorization signed with a full-access secp256k1 key.

signed.name: secp256k1_callback_url
signed.description: The same, with a callback URL.

verify_cases.name: curve_mismatch_ed25519_key
verify_cases.description: An ed25519 access key with a secp256k1 signature. The curves must match.

verify_cases.name: curve_mismatch_secp256k1_key
verify_cases.description: The mirror case: a secp256k1 access key with an ed25519 signature.

verify_cases.name: tampered_payload
verify_cases.description: The payload is the NEP-413 `message`, and is also bound through the nonce.

verify_cases.name: tampered_timestamp
verify_cases.description: The timestamp reaches the signature through both the nonce and `recipient`.

verify_cases.name: tampered_signer_id
verify_cases.description: `signer_id` is bound through both the nonce and `recipient`.

verify_cases.name: tampered_path
verify_cases.description: A path appended to a top-level authorization, which is bound through both the nonce and `recipient`.

verify_cases.name: tampered_callback_url
verify_cases.description: A callback URL that was never signed for: `via.extra.callback_url` is part of the signed NEP-413 payload.

verify_cases.name: secp256k1_recovery_byte_out_of_range
verify_cases.description: Byte 64 must be in `0..=3`, even though verification never recovers a public key. An implementation that verifies only the first 64 bytes accepts this.

verify_cases.name: secp256k1_high_s
verify_cases.description: The negated-S form of a signature that does verify: the same curve point, malleated.

verify_cases.name: ed25519_small_order_key
verify_cases.description: The order-8 generator as a public key. Low-order keys forge signatures for almost any message, and are rejected before any verification equation runs.

verify_cases.name: ed25519_non_canonical_s
verify_cases.description: `s` set to the group order exactly, the smallest non-canonical scalar. `s` must be reduced.

verify_cases.name: ed25519_non_canonical_r
verify_cases.description: `R` encoded with `y >= p`. `R` is compared as bytes, so a non-canonical encoding can never match.

verify_cases.name: ed25519_torsion_public_key
verify_cases.description: A public key carrying an order-8 torsion component, signed honestly. Verification here is cofactorless and rejects it; a cofactored verifier, which most high-level ed25519 libraries expose by default, accepts it. The key is not itself low order, so the small-order check does not catch it.

parse_cases.name: baseline
parse_cases.description: The unmodified blob, exactly as the reference serializes it.

parse_cases.name: baseline_with_path
parse_cases.description: A blob whose `path` is present and non-empty.

parse_cases.name: path_absent
parse_cases.description: `msg.path` has `serde(default)`, so an absent path is an empty one.

parse_cases.name: path_empty
parse_cases.description: An explicitly empty `path`, the form the reference skips when serializing.

parse_cases.name: extra_empty
parse_cases.description: No callback URL: `callback_url` has `serde(default)`.

parse_cases.name: extra_absent
parse_cases.description: `via` is adjacently tagged, so its content field is written unconditionally and is required on the way in.

parse_cases.name: unknown_top_level_field
parse_cases.description: `AccessKeyAuthorization` denies unknown fields, to reduce collisions with other authorization schemas.

parse_cases.name: unknown_field_in_msg
parse_cases.description: `OffchainMessage` carries no `deny_unknown_fields` of its own, so this is accepted.

parse_cases.name: unknown_field_in_extra
parse_cases.description: The `Nep413` variant body carries no `deny_unknown_fields` either.

parse_cases.name: unknown_field_in_via
parse_cases.description: Adjacent tagging looks for the tag and content keys and ignores strangers.

parse_cases.name: callback_url_null
parse_cases.description: `null` reads into an `Option` as `None`, exactly like an absent key.

parse_cases.name: callback_url_not_a_string
parse_cases.description: `callback_url` is a string when present.

parse_cases.name: extra_null
parse_cases.description: The content field must be the variant body, not `null`.

parse_cases.name: path_not_an_array
parse_cases.description: `path` is a list of account IDs.

parse_cases.name: unknown_schema
parse_cases.description: `nep413` is the only signature schema defined today.

parse_cases.name: via_not_an_object
parse_cases.description: `via` is the adjacently-tagged object, not a bare tag string.

parse_cases.name: missing_signature
parse_cases.description: Every field except `msg.path` and `via.extra.callback_url` is required.

parse_cases.name: missing_via
parse_cases.description: `via` is required.

parse_cases.name: uppercase_curve_prefix
parse_cases.description: The curve prefix is matched literally here, unlike the case-insensitive `TypedCurve::parse_base58`.

parse_cases.name: prefixless_key
parse_cases.description: A bare base58 key, with no curve prefix.

parse_cases.name: unknown_curve
parse_cases.description: Curves outside the enum are rejected at parse time.

parse_cases.name: key_all_zero
parse_cases.description: Base58 `1` is a zero byte, so this is a well-formed 32-byte key. Parsing validates the length, never the curve point: this one fails later, at verification.

parse_cases.name: key_too_short
parse_cases.description: Thirty-one zero bytes. Base58 keys are decoded to an exact length, never zero-padded.

parse_cases.name: key_too_long
parse_cases.description: The same length check from the other side.

parse_cases.name: signature_wrong_length
parse_cases.description: An ed25519 signature is exactly 64 bytes, not 32.

parse_cases.name: timestamp_not_rfc3339
parse_cases.description: `Timestamp` parses RFC-3339 only, not a bare nanosecond count.

parse_cases.name: invalid_signer_id
parse_cases.description: Account IDs are validated on deserialization.

parse_cases.name: foreign_authorization_blob
parse_cases.description: A blob meant for a contract-defined authorization schema must not parse as an access-key one.
